description: AbstractHonoClientFactory.java is an abstract class that provides a base implementation for client factory classes that manage Hono connections. It implements connection lifecycle methods such as connect, disconnect, and listener management, and maintains connection state. It serves as a foundational component for building specific client factories within the Hono client SDK.

classes.name: AbstractHonoClientFactory
classes.description: Provides a base implementation for Hono client factories managing connection lifecycle, including connection management, listener support, and disconnection handling.

methods.name: addDisconnectListener
methods.description: Adds a disconnect listener to the Hono connection, delegating the call to the underlying HonoConnection.

methods.name: addReconnectListener
methods.description: Adds a reconnect listener to the Hono connection, delegating the call to the underlying HonoConnection.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initiates a connection to the Hono service via the underlying HonoConnection.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the Hono connection is active, returning a Future that is succeeded if connected.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the Hono connection is active, with a timeout for ongoing connection attempts.

methods.name: getDefaultConnectionCheckTimeout
methods.description: Returns the default timeout for connection checks, derived from the connection's configuration.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the Hono connection and invokes a handler upon completion.

methods.name: onDisconnect
methods.description: Protected method invoked when the connection is lost unexpectedly; meant for subclasses to override for cleanup.
